'''Altros Logan''' resided in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. He owned [[The Corestrike Repository and Ore Exchange]]. Logan employed [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to guard his business since he was afraid of [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] associated with local criminal [[Themog]].<ref name="HNNA" />
